remarks: Cozy and well-maintained studio apartment offering a simple, efficient layout. The unit features a private kitchen, comfortable living and sleeping area. Off Street Parking. Located just minutes from downtown Norwalk, the property provides easy access to shopping, dining, and everyday essentials. It is also close to The SoNo Collection, the vibrant South Norwalk (SoNo) area, and the Maritime Aquarium at Norwalk, with convenient access to major highways and public transportation for an easy commute. This studio is ideal for someone seeking an affordable, centrally located living space in a lively and convenient neighborhood.
